```{r setup}
library(armvar)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
```

### Detection of cancer cells

# As an example, a thyroid cancer dataset from Gao et al. 2021 is loaded.
```{r}
#data <- readRDS('~/Project/datashare/rds/00_gao_2021.rds')
#cells_to_keep <- row.names(data@meta.data[data@meta.data$sample %in% c('TNBC1', 'TNBC2', 'TNBC3', 'TNBC4', 'TNBC5'),])
#gao_2021_breast_cancer_data <- subset(data, cells=cells_to_keep)
#usethis::use_data(gao_2021_breast_cancer_data, overwrite = TRUE)
data("gao_2021_breast_cancer_data")
```

```{r} 
armvar_res <- armvar(data = gao_2021_breast_cancer_data, k = 300, n_pcs = 50, n.cores = 3, heatmap = TRUE, heatmap_var = c('sample', 'published_annotation'))
```
# The classification results are returned in the data@meta.data, where we can find the classification without smoothing (welch_anova), the final classification of ArmVar (ArmVar_k300_pc50) and the smoothed F-statistic (smoothed_fstat_k300_pc50).  
```{r}
head(armvar_res$data@meta.data[, c('published_annotation', 'welch_anova', 'ArmVar_k300_pc50', 'smoothed_fstat_k300_pc50')])
```

```{r}
barplot1 <- ggplot(data = armvar_res$data@meta.data, aes(x=welch_anova, fill=published_annotation)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = paletteer::paletteer_d("ggthemes::Tableau_10")) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  geom_bar()

barplot2 <- ggplot(data = armvar_res$data@meta.data, aes(x=ArmVar_k300_pc50, fill = published_annotation)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = paletteer::paletteer_d("ggthemes::Tableau_10")) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_blank(), axis.text.y=element_blank()) +
  geom_bar()

legend <- get_legend(barplot2)
barplot2 <- barplot2 + theme(legend.position="none")

plot_grid(barplot1, barplot2, legend, ncol = 3, align='h', rel_widths = c(3,3,2))
```

# if heatmap variable(s) is/are specified, armvar generates an heatmap that can be visualized with this code:
```{r}
ComplexHeatmap::draw(armvar_res$heatmap_obj$heatmap, annotation_legend_list=armvar_res$heatmap_obj$legend)
```

# if no heatmap variable was specified, the heatmap can be generated with the data and the metadata of the armvar output:
```{r}
hm_object <- generate_heatmap(armvar_res$data, geneMetadata = armvar_res$geneMetadata, heatmap_var <-  c('sample', 'published_annotation'))

ComplexHeatmap::draw(armvar_res$heatmap_obj$heatmap, annotation_legend_list=armvar_res$heatmap_obj$legend)
```

### Simulation of tumor tissue

# We propose to use a PDAC dataset from Peng et al. 2019 because the healthy counterparts of the malignat cells have been identified (Ductal type 1). We recommend to use this kind of cells to simulate cancer cells.
```{r}
# peng_2019_pdac_data <- readRDS('~/Project/datashare/rds/00_peng_k_2019.rds')
# usethis::use_data(peng_2019_pdac_data, overwrite = TRUE)
# rm(peng_2019_pdac_data)
# data("peng_2019_pdac_data")

table(peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data[peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data$published_annotation == 'Ductal cell type 2', 'orig.ident'])
```

```{r}
# here we remove the sample T12 since it contains a low number of cancer cells and fastCNV seems to require more cells
cells_to_keep <- row.names(peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data[peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data$orig.ident != 'T12',])
peng_2019_pdac_data <- subset(peng_2019_pdac_data, cells = cells_to_keep)

# healthy cells from healthy tissu ('h') are selected to avoid selecting missannotated cancer cells
healthy_cells <- row.names(peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data[peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data$published_annotation == 'Ductal cell type 1' & peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data$tissue == 'h',])
cancer_cells <- row.names(peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data[peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data$published_annotation == 'Ductal cell type 2',])

foldchange_computation_res <- foldchange_computation(peng_2019_pdac_data, healthy_cells, cancer_cells, sample_col='orig.ident', topNGenes=15000)
```
# foldchange_computation returns the metadata of fastCNV that can be visualized to ensure the proper functionning of the tool
# The cnv_fraction represents the amount of CNAs in the cells (more precisely the proportion of windows with CNAs according to fastCNV)
# Here the ductal cell type 2 (malignant cells) and the ductal cell type 1 (healthy counterparts) are well separated

```{r}
ggplot(foldchange_computation_res$fastCNV_metadata, aes(x = cnv_fraction, fill = published_annotation)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5)
```
# The function also returns a list of patterns of CNAs identified in the tumor cells. 
# Here we can see that most of the cells present unique patterns of CNAs although there are some patterns shared between 2 up 8 cells. 

```{r}
patterns <- foldchange_computation_res$pattern_list
shared_patterns <- setNames(lapply(names(patterns), function(sample) {
  as.data.frame(table(sapply(patterns[[sample]], length))) |>
    dplyr::rename(cell_nb = Var1, pattern_nb = Freq)
}), names(patterns)) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "sample") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = pattern_nb,
    values_fill = 0
  )

shared_patterns$total <- rowSums(shared_patterns[,-grep('cell_nb', colnames(shared_patterns))])

ggplot(data=shared_patterns, aes(x=cell_nb, y=total)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = 'number of cells', y = 'nb of patterns', title = 'Number of patterns shared by cells')
```

```{r}
# Here we take cells from tumor tissues that are not tumor cells
tumor_microenvrnt_cells <- row.names(peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data[peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data$tissue == "pt" & peng_2019_pdac_data@meta.data$published_annotation != 'Ductal cell type 2',])

simulated_seurat_obj <- cancer_tissue_simulation(data = peng_2019_pdac_data, sample_nb_to_simulate=23, cancer_cell_nb_to_simulate=320, total_cell_in_sample=400, healthy_cells_to_transform=healthy_cells, tumor_microenvrnt_cells=tumor_microenvrnt_cells, sample_fc_list= foldchange_computation_res$sample_fc_list,  sample_col='orig.ident', seed=1)
```

```{r}
simulated_seurat_obj <- Seurat::NormalizeData(simulated_seurat_obj)
simulated_seurat_obj <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(simulated_seurat_obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000)
simulated_seurat_obj <- Seurat::ScaleData(simulated_seurat_obj, features = rownames(simulated_seurat_obj), do.scale = TRUE, do.center = TRUE,) # = z scoring
simulated_seurat_obj <- Seurat::RunPCA(simulated_seurat_obj, verbose = FALSE)
simulated_seurat_obj <- Seurat::RunUMAP(simulated_seurat_obj, dims = 1:50)

colors <- armvar::color_selection(simulated_seurat_obj, heatmap_var = c("group_origin", "published_annotation"))

umap1 <- Seurat::DimPlot(simulated_seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = 'published_annotation') +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)) +
  labs(x = "UMAP-1", y = "UMAP-2", color = "Published annotation", title="Cell type") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = 'center', legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$`Published annotation`) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5), nrow=ceiling(length(colors$`Published annotation`)/2)))

umap2 <- Seurat::DimPlot(simulated_seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = 'sample') +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)) +
  labs(x = "UMAP-1", y = "UMAP-2", color = "Sample", title="Simulated sample") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = 'center', legend.title = element_blank()) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5), nrow=ceiling(length(unique(simulated_seurat_obj@meta.data$sample))/4)))

umap3 <- Seurat::DimPlot(simulated_seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = 'tumor_sample_origin') +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = tumor_sample_colors) +
  labs(x = "UMAP-1", y = "", color = "", title="Tumor tissues of origin of the induced \n copy-number profiles") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = 'center', legend.title = element_blank()) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5), nrow=ceiling(length(unique(simulated_seurat_obj@meta.data$tumor_sample_origin))/4)))

umap4 <- Seurat::DimPlot(simulated_seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = 'group_origin') +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)) +
  labs(x = "UMAP-1", y = "", color = "", title="Healthy tissues of origin of the \n simulated tumor cells") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = 'center', legend.title = element_blank())+
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$`Group origin`) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5), nrow=ceiling(length(colors$`Group origin`)/4)))

print(plot_grid(umap1, umap2, umap3, umap4, nrow=1, align='h', rel_widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1)))
```
